scope: Curated high-value usage cards, not measured frequency rankings. Examples are synthetic; brackets require user evidence. Cards explain language and do not validate source findings.

cards.zh: 具有解释价值的阴性结果／假阴性风险
cards.use_when: 结合肿瘤分数、检测覆盖和参考检测解释液体活检阴性。
cards.confusable: 阴性不是没有肿瘤；低肿瘤分数下未检出不等于排除驱动改变。
cards.safe_example: No actionable alteration was detected within [assay scope], with interpretation conditioned on [tumor-fraction criterion].
cards.unsafe_example: A negative plasma test ruled out every actionable alteration.
cards.boundary: 保留实际检测范围、配对样本选择和条件分母；不能移植另一平台阈值。

cards.zh: 一致性分母／检测失败与不一致
cards.use_when: 先定义人、样本、改变层级及可评价范围，再报告一致率。
cards.confusable: 双阴性、同一可干预改变、任意共同改变是不同一致性定义；检测失败不是有效阴性。
cards.safe_example: Concordance was assessed for [alteration definition] among [paired evaluable specimens], with assay failures reported separately.
cards.unsafe_example: All failed tests were valid discordant results.
cards.boundary: 组内获益不等于标志物与治疗交互显著；生物异质性不是不一致的唯一原因。

cards.zh: 胚系来源预测与胚系确认
cards.use_when: 区分肿瘤单样本中的来源预测、匹配正常组织确认及遗传风险解释。
cards.confusable: 高VAF不是胚系确认；pathogenic注释不等于已经确认遗传来源。
cards.safe_example: The model estimated germline origin for [eligible variants]; confirmatory testing was considered separately.
cards.unsafe_example: The tumor-only model diagnosed an inherited cancer syndrome.
cards.boundary: 保留变异级与患者级分母，不能把判别能力当作校准或临床效用。

cards.zh: 外显率、传递概率与确诊年龄构成
cards.use_when: 明确分母是携带者、家系、已确诊肿瘤还是全部随访人时。
cards.confusable: 一定年龄前的病例占比不是该年龄前携带者的发病风险；50%遗传传递不是50%患癌。
cards.safe_example: Among diagnosed [tumors], [proportion] occurred before [age]; this proportion was not an estimate of penetrance among carriers.
cards.unsafe_example: The age distribution of affected probands established population lifetime risk.
cards.boundary: 先证者富集、家系聚集与随访差异限制风险估计；早期分期关联不能证明监测降低死亡。

cards.zh: 分子反应与替代终点的区别
cards.use_when: 报告治疗中ctDNA变化，保留时间点、检测下限和实际纳入配对样本。
cards.confusable: 未检出不是所有克隆消失；与生存相关不是已经验证的生存替代终点。
cards.safe_example: An on-treatment decline in [ctDNA measure] was associated with [endpoint] in [paired analysis set].
cards.unsafe_example: Undetectable ctDNA proved cure and validated a survival surrogate.
cards.boundary: 肿瘤分数与单个变异VAF不能混用，重复测量、可采样性及时间依赖偏倚需要考虑。

cards.zh: 与……相关／关联
cards.use_when: 报告观察性关联，并保留比较对象、调整状态和不确定性。
cards.confusable: association不等于causation；associated with poorer survival不等于reduces survival。
cards.safe_example: [Alteration] was associated with [endpoint] after adjustment for [covariates].
cards.unsafe_example: [Alteration] caused treatment failure.
cards.boundary: 不能从调整后的关联直接推断机制或治疗预测。

cards.zh: 尚未充分阐明／仍不明确
cards.use_when: 把知识缺口限定到具体人群、机制或分析情境。
cards.confusable: limited evidence不等于no evidence；unclear不等于never studied。
cards.safe_example: The role of [factor] in [defined setting] remains incompletely characterized.
cards.unsafe_example: No study has ever investigated [factor].
cards.boundary: 首次、唯一、从未等文献断言需额外检索；词句库本身不能证明。

cards.zh: 我们评估／研究／旨在阐明
cards.use_when: 陈述实际研究问题，不预先写成已证明的结论。
cards.confusable: evaluate与validate不同；探索并不等于验证。
cards.safe_example: We evaluated the association between [factor] and [endpoint].
cards.unsafe_example: We validated the causal role of [factor].
cards.boundary: 必须与已实施设计和分析匹配。

cards.zh: 可评价人群／分析集／分母
cards.use_when: 区分入组、治疗、疗效可评价、标志物可评价及配对样本集。
cards.confusable: patients、samples、lesions不能互换。
cards.safe_example: Among [N] response-evaluable patients, [n] had [response].
cards.unsafe_example: All enrolled patients contributed to every assay.
cards.boundary: 每个终点单独锁定分母，缺失与剔除需有记录。

cards.zh: 共突变／共改变／共同出现
cards.use_when: 按实际变异类型及条件人群报告共同出现。
cards.confusable: co-alteration范围比co-mutation宽；co-occurrence不是协同作用。
cards.safe_example: [Gene A] co-occurred with [gene B] within [genotype-defined population].
cards.unsafe_example: The genes cooperated biologically because they co-occurred.
cards.boundary: 保留KRAS亚型等条件；不要把拷贝数缺失改写为点突变。

cards.zh: 功能缺失／致病性／蛋白缺失／等位基因状态
cards.use_when: 分别说明序列变异注释、拷贝数与蛋白实验结果。
cards.confusable: predicted loss-of-function、biallelic inactivation与IHC蛋白缺失并非同义。
cards.safe_example: Variants were classified using [annotation rule]; protein expression was evaluated separately.
cards.unsafe_example: Every nonsynonymous mutation abolished protein expression.
cards.boundary: 阈值与功能结论不能从另一基因移植。

cards.zh: 调整后／多变量模型／风险比
cards.use_when: 给出效应方向、参照组、协变量及区间。
cards.confusable: multivariable不是multivariate；HR不是OR或RR。
cards.safe_example: The adjusted HR for [group] versus [reference] was [HR] (95% CI, [lower-upper]).
cards.unsafe_example: Adjustment eliminated all confounding.
cards.boundary: 不凭HR数字猜参照方向；区间必须与点估计对应。

cards.zh: 未达到统计学显著性／区间包含无效值
cards.use_when: 如实报告未显著结果，同时保留估计值和不确定性。
cards.confusable: 未显著不等于相同、等效或不存在关联。
cards.safe_example: The estimate favored [group], but the confidence interval included the null.
cards.unsafe_example: The treatments were equivalent because P exceeded 0.05.
cards.boundary: 不要用trend包装失败的显著性检验；等效性需要相应设计。

cards.zh: 交互作用／治疗效果预测性标志物
cards.use_when: 区分组内关联与治疗间效果差异。
cards.confusable: 一组显著另一组不显著，并不证明交互显著。
cards.safe_example: Whether the association differed by treatment requires a treatment-by-biomarker interaction analysis.
cards.unsafe_example: The biomarker predicted benefit because only one subgroup had P<0.05.
cards.boundary: 预后标志物不能自动升级为治疗选择标志物。

cards.zh: 主要终点／探索性／事后分析
cards.use_when: 完整保留预设性、终点层级和多重比较处理。
cards.confusable: 预设次要终点不等于主要终点；事后亚组不等于确证。
cards.safe_example: The primary endpoint was not met; [finding] arose from an exploratory analysis.
cards.unsafe_example: The trial succeeded because an exploratory subgroup improved.
cards.boundary: 摘要与结论不能淡化阴性主要终点。

cards.zh: 疾病控制／客观缓解／确认缓解
cards.use_when: 说明缓解标准、确认要求和人群。
cards.confusable: DCR包含的稳定疾病不能算成ORR；未确认与确认缓解不同。
cards.safe_example: Disease control and confirmed objective response are reported separately.
cards.unsafe_example: Disease control rate was the tumor response rate.
cards.boundary: 中枢与全身终点、病灶与患者分母分别报告。

cards.zh: 不良事件／耐受性／毒性／安全性
cards.use_when: 区分全因与治疗相关、分级、严重事件、停药和死亡。
cards.confusable: serious与severe不同；没有观察到不等于排除风险。
cards.safe_example: [n/N] patients experienced grade [grade] treatment-related adverse events.
cards.unsafe_example: The treatment was safe despite unreported fatal events.
cards.boundary: 不能用manageable替代实际严重毒性数据。

cards.zh: 反卷积／推断的免疫组成／bulk RNA测序
cards.use_when: 明确计算推断来自混合组织数据。
cards.confusable: 推断细胞比例不是单细胞实测比例。
cards.safe_example: Bulk expression profiles were used to infer [cell signature] using [method].
cards.unsafe_example: Single-cell sequencing demonstrated the cell proportions.
cards.boundary: 算法输出不等于独立实验验证。

cards.zh: 单细胞／单核／伪bulk
cards.use_when: 保留物种、样本、患者和细胞层级及统计单位。
cards.confusable: 细胞数不能当独立患者数；小鼠scRNA不是人类scRNA证据。
cards.safe_example: Expression was aggregated by [patient/sample] for pseudobulk analysis.
cards.unsafe_example: Thousands of cells represented thousands of independent patients.
cards.boundary: 仅在实际使用时陈述伪bulk、批次校正或独立验证。

cards.zh: 空间测量／多重成像
cards.use_when: 明确测量的是RNA、蛋白信号还是组织图像。
cards.confusable: 空间蛋白成像不是空间转录组；空间邻近不是直接相互作用。
cards.safe_example: Spatial proximity between [cell types] was quantified using [assay].
cards.unsafe_example: Neighboring cells were proven to signal directly.
cards.boundary: 共定位、富集、通讯推断与扰动验证分开。

cards.zh: 蛋白组学／逆相蛋白阵列／邻近延伸／液相色谱质谱
cards.use_when: 报告平台、覆盖、定量方法及QC后分析集合。
cards.confusable: 靶向面板、RPPA、流式不能直接叫无偏全蛋白组。
cards.safe_example: A targeted [N]-protein panel was analyzed; [n] proteins passed quality control.
cards.unsafe_example: A targeted panel comprehensively measured the entire proteome.
cards.boundary: label-free与TMT等来源冲突未解决前不能替作者选择。

cards.zh: 细胞通讯推断／配体／受体／信号通路
cards.use_when: 根据实际方法区分表达、评分、通路读出和直接干预。
cards.confusable: 推断通讯不等于分泌实测；通路评分不等于生化活性。
cards.safe_example: The analysis inferred [interaction], which requires experimental confirmation.
cards.unsafe_example: The computation proved secretion and receptor activation.
cards.boundary: 通路激活也不自动证明药物敏感性增加。

cards.zh: 外部验证／独立队列／交叉验证／训练
cards.use_when: 注明患者、中心、时间、拆分、调参及测试隔离。
cards.confusable: 内部随机拆分或交叉验证不是外部验证。
cards.safe_example: Performance was assessed in a held-out internal test set.
cards.unsafe_example: An internal random split established external generalizability.
cards.boundary: 不能因检索到模板就补造验证步骤。

cards.zh: 曲线下面积／区分度／临床效用／校准度
cards.use_when: 写清预测目标、时间窗、集合和不确定性。
cards.confusable: 区分度、校准度及临床效用不同；AUC不是生存C-index的通用替代词。
cards.safe_example: The model discriminated [outcome] in [test set], with an AUC of [value].
cards.unsafe_example: The AUC proved clinical usefulness.
cards.boundary: 可迁移性与临床应用需额外证据。

cards.zh: 敲除／敲低／同基因背景／救援实验
cards.use_when: 说明模型、对照、扰动、重复和读出。
cards.confusable: 非同基因背景细胞系对比不能代替受控扰动；敲低不同于敲除。
cards.safe_example: In isogenic [model], [perturbation] altered [measured endpoint].
cards.unsafe_example: Two unrelated cell lines established gene-specific causality.
cards.boundary: 机制证据的结论范围限于实际模型与干预。

cards.zh: 半数抑制浓度／药物敏感性／抗肿瘤活性
cards.use_when: 分清药物、浓度、时间、终点、模型与方向。
cards.confusable: IC50升高通常不是敏感性提高；体外活性不是患者获益。
cards.safe_example: [Drug] reduced [readout] in [model] under [conditions].
cards.unsafe_example: Cell-line activity established clinical efficacy.
cards.boundary: 来源曲线与正文矛盾时隔离方向性结论。

cards.zh: 受……限制／局限性／混杂／回顾性
cards.use_when: 说明具体限制影响哪项推断，而不是套用通用免责声明。
cards.confusable: 翻译原文时不能默默补上作者未写的限制。
cards.safe_example: [Limitation] limits inference about [specific claim].
cards.unsafe_example: All bias was excluded by multivariable adjustment.
cards.boundary: 翻译正文与新增科学审查意见分开输出。

cards.zh: 值得进一步研究／支持进一步评估／提供研究依据
cards.use_when: 把结论限制到已有证据，并指向可验证的问题。
cards.confusable: supports evaluation不是supports immediate clinical adoption。
cards.safe_example: These findings support prospective evaluation of [hypothesis].
cards.unsafe_example: These findings establish a new standard of care.
cards.boundary: 阴性主要终点与探索性分析仍需明确保留。

cards.zh: 图表叙事：研究对象→比较→观察→边界
cards.use_when: 让每段与实际图表和分析集合对应。
cards.confusable: 图题可以概括观察，不能用推断机制替代图中测量。
cards.safe_example: Figure [number] summarizes [measured features] in [analysis set].
cards.unsafe_example: The figure proves a mechanism not tested in the study.
cards.boundary: 参考论文提供组织方法，不授权补造本研究图表。

cards.zh: 克隆性造血／造血来源变异
cards.use_when: 描述血浆变异来源判定及实际采用的配对白细胞分析。
cards.confusable: 血浆检出不等于肿瘤来源；白细胞变异也不是自动排除所有肿瘤变异。
cards.safe_example: [Variants] were also detected in matched leukocyte DNA, consistent with a hematopoietic origin.
cards.unsafe_example: Every plasma variant represented tumor-derived ctDNA.
cards.boundary: 没有配对或来源证据时用可能来源，不能补造检测。

cards.zh: 剂量依赖／浓度依赖／剂量反应
cards.use_when: 在实际剂量或浓度系列中说明读出变化。
cards.confusable: 体外浓度不等于体内给药剂量；两点差异不自动证明完整单调曲线。
cards.safe_example: [Readout] decreased with increasing [drug] concentrations over [tested range].
cards.unsafe_example: One treated group proved a dose-dependent response.
cards.boundary: 保留范围、时点、模型和非单调现象，不由模板补出趋势。

cards.zh: 富集于／富集分析／过度代表
cards.use_when: 指明富集对象、参照集合及检验或评分方法。
cards.confusable: 基因集富集不等于通路生化激活；频率富集不等于绝对数量增加。
cards.safe_example: [Gene set] was enriched in [group] relative to [reference] ([reported statistic]).
cards.unsafe_example: Enrichment proved pathway activation and drug sensitivity.
cards.boundary: 只有实际报告时填写NES、OR、q值；不同富集方法的量不可互换。

cards.zh: 差异表达／对数倍数变化
cards.use_when: 写清比较方向、特征、统计单位、筛选阈值与多重校正。
cards.confusable: RNA差异不等于蛋白差异；差异表达不等于功能依赖。
cards.safe_example: [Gene] expression was higher in [group] than in [reference] (log2 fold change, [value]; adjusted P, [value]).
cards.unsafe_example: Differential RNA expression confirmed protein activation.
cards.boundary: 未提供估计和校正时保留缺项，不编数字或算法。

cards.zh: 细胞状态／推断轨迹／拟时序
cards.use_when: 描述状态分布及计算推断的连续变化。
cards.confusable: 拟时序不是实际时间或谱系追踪；簇标签不必等于稳定细胞类型。
cards.safe_example: Trajectory analysis placed [states] along an inferred continuum.
cards.unsafe_example: Pseudotime proved that each cell differentiated into the next cluster.
cards.boundary: 谱系与因果演变需要相应证据；保留患者层级。

cards.zh: 最近邻距离／空间邻近／共定位
cards.use_when: 按图像或空间测量说明细胞对、区域、距离或共定位定义。
cards.confusable: 这些指标相关但不相同；邻近不等于物理接触或配体受体通讯。
cards.safe_example: The nearest-neighbor distance between [cell types] was [comparison] in [regions].
cards.unsafe_example: Cell proximity proved functional signaling.
cards.boundary: 区域和细胞嵌套于患者；不要把区域数当患者数。

cards.zh: 蛋白丰度／蛋白表达／磷酸化
cards.use_when: 说明实际检测的总蛋白、修饰位点、标准化方式及平台。
cards.confusable: 总量不是酶活性；单个位点信号也不自动代表整个通路。
cards.safe_example: [Assay] showed [direction] in [measured protein or phosphosite] relative to [control].
cards.unsafe_example: Higher total protein proved greater enzymatic activity.
cards.boundary: 只有直接活性读出或充分验证才作活性结论。

cards.zh: 跨组学一致性／多组学整合
cards.use_when: 说明是否配对样本及各模态测量与整合方法。
cards.confusable: 不同队列方向一致不等于同一患者多组学配对；一致性不是因果。
cards.safe_example: [Pattern] was concordant across [specified datasets], which were [paired/unpaired].
cards.unsafe_example: Unpaired datasets established patient-level RNA–protein coupling.
cards.boundary: 不能把空间蛋白、bulk RNA、其他瘤种scRNA合成同一队列。

cards.zh: 特征选择／留出评估／数据泄漏
cards.use_when: 描述训练、调参、特征选择和测试的真实隔离方式。
cards.confusable: 在全部样本筛特征后拆分不是真正无泄漏测试。
cards.safe_example: [Features/model] were selected in [training set] and evaluated in [held-out set].
cards.unsafe_example: Selecting predictors on all data preserved independent test performance.
cards.boundary: 不知道步骤顺序时发出查询，不声称已避免泄漏。

cards.zh: 批次校正／批次效应调整
cards.use_when: 说明真实方法和保留生物差异的评估。
cards.confusable: 整合后视觉混合不证明批次偏倚完全消失。
cards.safe_example: [Method] was used to account for [recorded batch variable].
cards.unsafe_example: Batch correction eliminated all technical and biological confounding.
cards.boundary: 不可凭常见流程补写Harmony、ComBat或其他方法。

cards.zh: 救援／回补表达／恢复
cards.use_when: 说明回补对象、对照以及部分或完全恢复的实际读出。
cards.confusable: 部分恢复不等于完全逆转；过表达回补不等于内源生理条件。
cards.safe_example: Re-expression of [gene] partially restored [readout] in [perturbed model].
cards.unsafe_example: A partial rescue proved the sole mechanism in patients.
cards.boundary: 读出、模型和恢复程度必须由实际实验支撑。

cards.zh: 靶点结合或作用证据／靶点占有率
cards.use_when: 报告具体药效学检测、时点和实际测量指标。
cards.confusable: engagement、occupancy和下游调控并非同一个量；暴露不是疗效。
cards.safe_example: [Assay] provided evidence of target engagement at [exposure/time].
cards.unsafe_example: Target engagement established a survival benefit.
cards.boundary: 只有实际测量占有率时用occupancy及百分数。

cards.zh: 联合用药相互作用／协同
cards.use_when: 说明比较基线、评分框架、符号约定和浓度范围。
cards.confusable: 优于单药不自动等于协同；不同评分的正负号不可套用。
cards.safe_example: The combination showed [interaction] under [specified model and sign convention].
cards.unsafe_example: A smaller tumor with combination therapy alone proved pharmacologic synergy.
cards.boundary: 查阅来源定义；PMID37289191的负delta-area方向不可倒置。

cards.zh: 缓解持续时间／持续缓解
cards.use_when: 在缓解者中说明起点、事件、删失和随访成熟度。
cards.confusable: DOR不是全体患者PFS；观察到仍缓解不等于无限持续。
cards.safe_example: Among responders, median duration of response was [estimate] at [cutoff].
cards.unsafe_example: Responder-only duration established longer PFS in all enrolled patients.
cards.boundary: 未达到中位数时按实际结果写not reached，不杜撰数值。

cards.zh: 错误发现率／多重检验校正P值／q值
cards.use_when: 保留实际校正方法、检验集合、阈值和统计量名称。
cards.confusable: 原始P值不是q值；FDR阈值不是单个发现为假的后验概率。
cards.safe_example: [Features] met the prespecified [actual threshold] after [reported correction].
cards.unsafe_example: A q value of 0.05 means this specific hypothesis has a 5% probability of being false.
cards.boundary: 没有预设或校正资料时不可补写prespecified或FDR。

cards.zh: 配对／纵向／治疗中／基线
cards.use_when: 锁定同一患者时点、样本对数、缺失和实际模型。
cards.confusable: 基线与治疗后组数相同不证明配对；横断面不能写成个体变化。
cards.safe_example: In [n] paired samples, [readout] changed from baseline to [time point].
cards.unsafe_example: Unmatched cross-sectional groups demonstrated within-patient evolution.
cards.boundary: 不要自动添加配对检验、混合模型或时间因果关系。

cards.zh: 正交检测／相互印证
cards.use_when: 用另一测量原理或独立证据检查同一明确观察。
cards.confusable: 换算法分析同一数据不是独立实验；相互印证不等于证实机制。
cards.safe_example: The [specific observation] was corroborated using [actual second assay].
cards.unsafe_example: Two analyses of the same data proved clinical validity.
cards.boundary: 说清第二证据测量什么及与第一证据的对应关系。

cards.zh: 尚不明确／研究空白／研究问题过渡
cards.use_when: 连接已引用证据与本研究实际问题，而不是堆砌新颖性修饰。
cards.confusable: 未在自己的库找到不等于全球尚无人研究。
cards.safe_example: Whether [specified relationship] holds in [population] remains unclear.
cards.unsafe_example: No study has ever examined this question because none was retrieved locally.
cards.boundary: 空白和首次性主张需要检索支撑；翻译时不新增这些主张。
